name: Eddard Stark
biography: Lord Eddard Stark of Winterfell was the very embodiment of northern honor — a man whose moral compass never deviated, even when deviation might have saved his life. Summoned south by his old friend King Robert Baratheon to serve as Hand of the King, Eddard uncovered the treasonous secret that Joffrey Baratheon was not the king's son but the product of incest between Queen Cersei and her twin brother Jaime. His honor demanded he confront this truth openly, his naivety demanded he give Cersei warning, and both together delivered him to the executioner's block in the Great Sept of Baelor — an act that shattered the realm and ignited the War of the Five Kings.
keyMoments: Learning the truth of Joffrey's birth
quotes: The man who passes the sentence should swing the sword.
I learned that from you when I was a boy. You told me to never forget it.
In the name of Robert of the House Baratheon... I, Eddard of the House Stark, Lord of Winterfell and Warden of the North, sentence you to death.

name: Jon Snow
titles: Lord Commander of the Night's Watch
biography: Born Aegon Targaryen — the secret son of Prince Rhaegar Targaryen and Lyanna Stark — Jon Snow was raised as Ned Stark's bastard to protect him from Robert Baratheon's wrath. He took the black, rose to Lord Commander of the Night's Watch, was murdered by his own brothers, resurrected by Melisandre, and ultimately declared King in the North. He bent the knee to Daenerys Targaryen, fell in love with her, learned his true parentage, and finally — when she chose fire and madness — drove a blade through her heart. He ended the Long Night and ended the Mother of Dragons in the same generation, bearing both crowns of heroism and heartbreak.
keyMoments: Taking the black at Castle Black
Battle of the Fist of the First Men
quotes: The night is dark and full of terrors.
I am the shield that guards the realms of men.
I don't want it.
She is my queen.

name: Daenerys Targaryen
titles: Khaleesi of the Great Grass Sea
Queen of the Andals and the First Men
biography: She was born in the middle of a great storm, the last of her father's children, and she was never meant to survive. Sold to a Dothraki warlord, she walked into her husband's funeral pyre and emerged as the Mother of Dragons — unburnt, unbroken, and terrible in her conviction. For seven seasons she was the world's great hope: liberator of slaves, protector of the small, breaker of the wheel that ground men to dust. Then in a single morning over King's Landing, surrounded by the sound of bells that should have meant surrender, something in her broke. Or perhaps revealed itself. The city burned, and with it every claim she had to being different from her father.
keyMoments: Surviving the pyre and hatching dragons
Beyond the Wall — death of Viserion
quotes: I am not your little princess. I am Daenerys Stormborn of the blood of Old Valyria, and I will take what is mine with fire and blood.
Dragons plant no trees. Remember that. Remember who you are, what you were made to be. Remember your words.
I will not stop the wheel. I will break the wheel.

name: Cersei Lannister
biography: Cersei Lannister was a woman of extraordinary intellect trapped in a world that had no use for women's minds — and she never forgave the world for it. Her only acknowledged sin was loving her children too completely, and her greatest vulnerability was her conviction that she could match wits with every man in the realm simultaneously. As queen, queen regent, and finally queen in her own right, she played the game with ruthless efficiency, eliminating threats through wildfire, prophecy, and the simple expedient of outliving her enemies. The Red Keep's collapse proved that even the most indomitable will cannot hold a mountain of rubble at bay.
keyMoments: Destroying the Great Sept with wildfire
quotes: When you play the game of thrones, you win or you die.
I choose violence.
I will burn our house to the ground before I let that happen.

name: Tyrion Lannister
biography: The wit of Westeros, wearing the face of a man the world was determined to underestimate. Tyrion Lannister was born a dwarf into the richest family in the realm, and spent his life paying for the crime of his birth — his mother's death in childbirth, for which his father Tywin never forgave him. He survived through intelligence, drink, and the dark insight that comes from having no illusions about humanity. As Hand of the King under Joffrey, he arguably saved King's Landing at the Battle of the Blackwater. As Hand of the Queen under Daenerys, he failed spectacularly but survived to write the world's history.
keyMoments: Becoming Hand of the King to Bran
quotes: I drink and I know things.
That's what I do. I drink and I know things.
Never forget what you are. The rest of the world will not. Wear it like armor, and it can never be used to hurt you.

name: Jaime Lannister
biography: Called the Kingslayer for driving his sword through the back of the man he swore to protect — a name he wore as a brand of shame for seventeen years without ever explaining that killing Aerys was the act that saved half a million lives. Jaime Lannister was the finest swordsman of his generation, a man constructed entirely of paradox: loyal to his vows and violating them; capable of extraordinary cruelty and staggering compassion. Losing his sword hand unmade him completely, then forced him to rebuild himself from nothing. His final choice — to return to Cersei rather than stand with the living — is either profound romantic fatalism or simple moral cowardice, and history will argue both.
quotes: There are no men like me. Only me.
By what right does the wolf judge the lion?
I did it to save the city, not to betray a king.

name: Arya Stark
biography: She was never a lady, and she never wanted to be. Arya Stark — smallest of Ned's children, most ferocious of his legacy — survived betrayal, war, blindness, and years of training in the House of Black and White to become something the faceless assassins could not have anticipated: not no one, but very specifically someone. Someone with a list. Someone who remembered every name. She killed the Night King with a catspaw dagger — a moment so unexpected it defied every prophecy — and then she sailed west of Westeros, past the edge of every map, to discover what lies at the end of the world.
quotes: Not today.
A girl has no name.
I am not a lady. I never have been.

name: Sansa Stark
biography: She wanted songs and stories, chivalry and romance — and instead received a masterclass in political survival administered by the most dangerous players in the realm. Sansa Stark was tutored in cruelty by Joffrey, in manipulation by Cersei, in long game strategy by Littlefinger, and in resilience by Ramsay Bolton's unspeakable treatment. Each teacher made her harder and wiser, until the girl who dreamed of being a southern queen became the woman who outmaneuvered Littlefinger himself and secured the North's independence when every other kingdom bent the knee.
quotes: I am a slow learner, it's true. But I learn.
Only a fool would trust Littlefinger.
The North remembers.

name: Brandon Stark
biography: He was pushed from a tower window, and the fall that was meant to kill him opened something ancient inside him. Bran Stark lost the use of his legs and gained access to the entire river of human memory — past, present, perhaps even future. The boy who loved climbing became the Three-Eyed Raven, a consciousness that extended beyond the individual into something vast and strange. Whether the boy Bran still exists within that ancient current of awareness is a question he himself declined to answer. He emerged from the Long Night as King of the Six Kingdoms — chosen not for his power but for his story.
quotes: I'm not Brandon Stark anymore.
I don't want to be the Lord of anything.
Why do you think I came all this way?

name: Robb Stark
biography: He won every battle and lost the war. Robb Stark — nineteen years old when the realm exploded around him — was declared King in the North and proceeded to outthink and outfight every army in the field. Undefeated on the battlefield, he was felled by an oath broken in love: his marriage to Talisa Maegyr, a decision born of honor and sealed with disaster. At the Twins, at the Red Wedding, Robb Stark died at Walder Frey's table after breaking bread with his hosts — a violation of guest right that shocked even a world accustomed to war.
quotes: I will take back the North.
My father didn't betray his family, he protected it.
Hang them all.

name: Tywin Lannister
biography: The most powerful man in Westeros who was never king — and who preferred it that way. Tywin Lannister built the Lannister legacy from the rubble of his father's failed lordship, restored the family's feared reputation through ruthless example, and held the Seven Kingdoms together through sheer force of political will for decades. He was incapable of genuine warmth, unable to acknowledge his own son's genius, and determined to shape history through bloodlines rather than relationships. He died on a privy, crossbow bolt through the chest, shot by the son he had dismissed and despised — the most ignominious end for the most formidable man of his age.
quotes: A lion doesn't concern himself with the opinions of sheep.
Any man who must say 'I am the king' is no true king.
The Rains of Castamere.

name: Oberyn Martell
biography: Prince Oberyn Martell came to King's Landing for a wedding and justice, and found neither. The Red Viper of Dorne — so named for his use of poison — was a man of tremendous contradictions: a scholar and a fighter, a lover without jealousy, a politician who found the political game beneath him. His sister Elia's rape and murder by Gregor Clegane during the Sack of King's Landing defined his life's purpose. When he volunteered as Tyrion's champion in trial by combat against the Mountain, he almost won. Almost. The Mountain's thumbs pressing inward against his eyes wrote the last line of one of the great tragic stories in Westerosi history.
quotes: Tell your father I'm here. Tell him the Lannisters aren't the only ones who pay their debts.
You raped her. You murdered her. You killed her children.
You want a confession? Say her name.

name: Melisandre
biography: She was ancient — four centuries old beneath that beautiful face — a red priestess from the shadowbound city of Asshai who had spent her long life searching for the Prince That Was Promised. She chose Stannis Baratheon as her vessel for divine purpose and drove him to catastrophe and his daughter's death for a war he could not win. She resurrected Jon Snow. She lit the Dothraki arakhs at Winterfell's darkest hour. She called Arya Stark's eyes 'eyes I've seen in my visions — brown, blue, green.' And when the Long Night ended, she walked into the dawn without her ruby choker and let four centuries crumble into ash.
keyMoments: Death at dawn after the Long Night
quotes: The night is dark and full of terrors.
Death by fire is the purest death.
I have been ready to die for many years.

name: Theon Greyjoy
biography: A ward — which is to say, a hostage — of House Stark, Theon Greyjoy spent his formative years in Winterfell, belonging nowhere. Not truly a Stark, not truly allowed to be a Greyjoy. His betrayal of Robb Stark and seizure of Winterfell was less military strategy than existential scream — a desperate attempt to prove to his father that he was ironborn enough to matter. What followed was years of suffering under Ramsay Bolton that destroyed the man called Theon and left something hollowed out in his place. From that hollow space, slowly, Theon Greyjoy reassembled himself — choosing Sansa over Euron, choosing Bran over cowardice. He died charging the Night King alone. He died as himself.
quotes: I'm not your ward, I'm your prisoner.
Theon Greyjoy. I'm Theon Greyjoy.
I am Theon Greyjoy.

name: Joffrey Baratheon
titles: King of the Andals and the First Men
biography: He was not Robert Baratheon's son but wore Robert's crown, not a true Baratheon but played at being a lion. Joffrey was a boy-king of exceptional cruelty — not the calculating cruelty of his grandfather Tywin but the impulsive, sadistic cruelty of a child who had never been told no. His execution of Eddard Stark, a decision taken against all political advice, ignited the War of the Five Kings. His treatment of Sansa Stark became a catalogue of public humiliation. He died at his own wedding feast, purple-faced and thrashing, poisoned — the realm's sweetest secret.
quotes: I am the king! I will punish you.
Everyone is mine to torment.

name: Stannis Baratheon
biography: Stannis Baratheon had the best claim to the Iron Throne — and almost everything else went against him. Humorless, inflexible, allergic to the human warmth that makes men follow willingly rather than from duty, Stannis was a military genius who could never translate tactical victories into political sustainability. He was right about almost everything: the corruption of the Lannisters, the threat beyond the Wall, the necessity of unity against the dead. Being right was not sufficient. Burning his own daughter for a victory that came from Bolton treason rather than his gods proved that even the most righteous conviction can consume the one who carries it.
quotes: I will take no joy in the killing, but I will do what is necessary.
Fewer.
A good act does not wash out the bad, nor a bad act the good.

name: Brienne of Tarth
biography: A woman who wanted only to be a knight in a world that had no place for such a woman — so she became the greatest knight of her generation through sheer force of will and superior combat skill. Brienne of Tarth pledged herself to causes rather than lords: first Renly Baratheon, then Catelyn Stark, then Sansa Stark, then Arya, then all of the living against the dead. She was knighted by Jaime Lannister himself — a man she loved and then had to watch choose his sister over his better self. She ended Stannis Baratheon's life in Catelyn's name, and she wrote Jaime Lannister's story in the Book of Brothers.
quotes: All my life men like you've sneered at me, and all my life I've been knocking men like you into the dust.
I am no man.
Jaime Lannister... I loved him.

name: Petyr Baelish
biography: Chaos isn't a pit. Chaos is a ladder. Petyr Baelish — Littlefinger — climbed from minor lordling to master of the realm's finances to kingmaker through a combination of financial genius, comprehensive intelligence networks, and an utter absence of anything resembling scruple. He loved Catelyn Tully, which was his only genuine emotion, and he redirected that love into a possessive obsession with Sansa Stark that was its most dangerous expression. He orchestrated the War of the Five Kings from backstage. He killed Jon Arryn and Lysa Tully with the same calm calculation. He was undone not by an enemy but by three Stark children who had learned enough of his own lessons to turn them against him.
quotes: Chaos isn't a pit. Chaos is a ladder.
A man with no motive is a man no one suspects. Always keep your foes confused.
I know the contents of their hearts.

name: Varys
biography: He claimed to serve the realm rather than any king — and there is evidence he was telling the truth, which makes him more dangerous than any man who serves only himself. Varys's network of little birds — children trained to listen in every dark corner of the realm — made him the most informed man in Westeros. He supported Daenerys's cause when he believed she could bring peace, and he wrote letters exposing Jon Snow's true parentage when he believed she could not. Daenerys had him burned for it. He died for the conviction that the realm needed a different ruler, which may be the most honest death any man in this story achieved.
quotes: I serve the realm. Someone must.
Power resides where men believe it resides.
Fire consumes, but cold preserves.

name: Sandor Clegane
biography: His face told the story before he ever spoke — half of it burned by his own brother's hand when they were children, because Sandor had picked up one of Gregor's toys without permission. The Hound's entire life was a negotiation with that wound: the rage it created, the fear of fire it instilled, the bitterness that armored him against any connection. And yet something in him reached toward decency, expressed in twisted loyalty to Sansa Stark, in protecting Arya Stark more faithfully than anyone else managed, in ultimately choosing to face his brother rather than flee. He fought the Mountain alone in the Red Keep's burning halls, and they fell together.
keyMoments: The Hound vs. The Mountain — Cleganebowl
quotes: Fuck the King.
Someday you'll have to kill a man. Here it is. Do it.
I knew this would happen eventually. Knew you'd come for me.
